description: One Go daemon with the HTTP API of Elasticsearch and the filters of MongoDB over plain NDJSON files: collections, queries, aggregates, lookups, watch and ack for outbox consumers, with SDKs for Go, Ruby, Rails and TypeScript.
rules: Connect over the unix socket by default (unix:///run/ndb/ndb.sock), or set NDB_URL (unix://, tcp://, http(s)://).
Filters use the MongoDB operators ($eq, $in, $gt, $and, $or, $elemMatch); routes are the Elasticsearch ones (POST /{coll}/_search, /_aggregate, /_bulk, /_count).
An update with a filter is atomic: send the _v (version) of the document in the filter for optimistic concurrency.
Use a unique field (unique: [field]) for a natural key such as email or call_id, not a custom id.
Page with the next cursor (X-Ndb-Next, after), not with a large skip.
For an outbox, use _watch and ack: a consumer resumes from its cursor after a restart.
